ontology.note: Existing ontology alignment; full configuration and port shape contracts remain to be defined. Emits is empty because the terms this widget's provenance asserts are written by src/raster-provenance.ts, while implementation.definition names src/core.ts#TYPES; the release declares what the defining module asserts, which is nothing of its own.

changes.description: Reads a NetCDF-4 grid chosen from this device, in parts, in a worker: a regular latitude-longitude grid, one variable chosen where the file holds several, its fill value, scale factor and offset applied as CF says. Its coordinates are where its values sit, so it is read as the cells around them and recorded as point-registered. The window around the study area is kept as a GeoTIFF window is, and the file's chunks meet the same 64 MB decoding budget as a GeoTIFF's tiles. A classic NetCDF-3 file is refused by name. The reader, h5wasm, is now saved for offline use (experiment 198, step 2).

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. 0.6.0: tests/raster-point-registration.test.mjs checks a point grid read as cells around its nodes, and a window keeping each value at its node; EGM2008 read from cdn.proj.org at the Manila gauge gives 43.009 m bilinearly, PROJ's value.
